Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代，孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁边。可是孟母注意，住在墓地的旁边影响孟子。他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩，所以孟母决定他们会搬家。这次，他们住在城市里的商店的旁边，从早到晚很吵。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代，孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁边：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 可是孟母注意：注意到，注意action vs.注意到result
- 他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩：祭拜着玩儿，V.着玩儿 do something just for fun
- 所以孟母决定他们会搬家：决定搬家
- 从早到晚很吵：都很吵

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 注意：注意到，when the verb means noticing a fact or situation, it needs the result complement 到. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 祭拜玩：学着祭拜，祭拜 is a verb, so it cannot directly modify 玩 in this order; 学着祭拜 expresses copying the ritual as a game. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 决定他们会搬家：决定搬家，决定 is followed directly by the action that is decided; do not repeat the people who will perform it. [teacher rule: jueding_vp]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子跟孟母：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和妈妈，at first mention, introduce the main character with a name and a brief identity before using shorter references. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟母：她，when this character was mentioned in the immediately previous sentence and no female character competes, use a pronoun rather than repeating the name. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
6. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 可是：—，可是 introduces contrast, but the previous sentence does not set up an expectation that the next sentence opposes; begin the observation directly instead. [rule: none]

items.reason: 注意这里表示“notice a fact,”需要用结果补语“到”。
“祭拜玩”缺少连接这两个动作的形式；“学着祭拜”是语法正确且符合模仿祭拜之意的改法。
按教师标准，“决定”后直接接所决定的动作，不应再加“他们会”。
孟子首次出现时需要作简短介绍，但所示改文在“他和妈妈”处截断，单独并不完整。
孟母刚在前一句出现，按教师的近距离指代规则应改用“她”；但“可是她注意”仍缺少“到”。
这里“可是”可以自然地引出孟母对居住在墓地旁这一情况的转折性反应，并非错误。
